scientific_integrity: The proof for all integer orders and real twists is analytical. The supplied finite enumeration is a regression test only; no external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The two polygons must be congruent regular polygons with concentric projections, equal circumradius and positive plane separation.
The theorem does not classify every nonvertex equality tetrahedron or arbitrary off-axis prismatoids.
Historical priority could be affected by an unindexed equivalent formula or special-angle literature; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Sharp tetrahedral-volume envelope of twisted regular polygonal prisms
